article.title: Birrieria Zaragoza
article.excerpt: This small, family-owned Chicago Mexican restaurant specializes in barbecued goat. It is the best barbecued goat I have had, the best accompanying sauce I have had outside of Mexico (you must order it separately), and the best tortillas I have had outside of Mexico.
